---
title: "Interactive Layout Viewer"
description: "Explore public OrPen layout exports in a static browser-only viewer."
---

The viewer below is part of the generated static site. It supports panning,
zooming, reset, and component selection entirely in the browser; it does not
need Python, a notebook kernel, or a server-side layout service.

<iframe class="layout-viewer-frame" src="layout-viewer/index.html" title="Interactive OrPen layout viewer"></iframe>

::: {.callout-note}
## Scope

This first viewer uses the repository's publication-safe SVG exports. It is
intended for visual inspection, not GDS sign-off or layer-rule verification.
:::
